# extractRangeFromA1Notation

<link-summary>Takes the range part out of an A1 notation.</link-summary>

<web-summary>extractRangeFromA1Notation() — Takes the range part out of an A1 notation. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.6.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function extractRangeFromA1Notation(a1Notation: string): string | null;
```

Everything after the `!` — and the whole string when there is no `!` at all, since a bare notation is already only a range.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type     | Description           |
| :----------- | :------- | :-------------------- |
| `a1Notation` | `string` | The notation to read. |

## Returns

`string | null` — the range part.

## Examples

### Extracting

```javascript
extractRangeFromA1Notation("Sheet1!A1:B2"); // => "A1:B2"
```
